source.title: Japanese Ginkgo Leaves Poster, Vintage Botanical Art Print, Yellow Floral Wall Art, Traditional Woodblock Style, Zen Nature Home Decor

analysis.summary: A vibrant Japanese woodblock print featuring cascading bright yellow ginkgo leaves and small fruits against a muted, textured background.
analysis.subject: A branch of a ginkgo tree with fan-shaped leaves and small round fruits.
analysis.setting: An ethereal, minimalist space suggested by a soft, grainy, sage-grey background.
analysis.action: The branch gracefully droops downward as if weighted by the autumn harvest, with a few tiny leaves drifting in the air.
analysis.style: Japanese woodblock print (Shin-hanga style), featuring delicate black outlines, flat yet textured color fills, and a visible washi paper grain texture.
analysis.composition: Vertical orientation with an asymmetrical, diagonal flow from the top-right toward the bottom-left; utilizes significant negative space and includes traditional red seals and vertical calligraphy in the margins.
analysis.typography: Vertical Japanese kanji characters in black ink on the left and right sides, accompanied by three distinct red square and circular artist seals.
analysis.mood: Tranquil, elegant, contemplative, and seasonally evocative of a quiet autumn day.
analysis.audience: Homeowners seeking a 'Japandi' or Zen aesthetic, botanical art collectors, and those decorating bedrooms or meditation spaces.
analysis.hook: The striking visual pop of saturated, electric yellow against a desaturated, grainy background creates a sophisticated focal point that feels both ancient and modern.

outputs.title: Cascading Golden Ginkgo
outputs.brief: A vertical branch of ginkgo enters from the top-right corner, draped with electric yellow fan-shaped leaves and small round yellow fruits. The arrangement follows a diagonal descent toward the bottom-left, featuring a few loose leaves drifting in the air. The background is a muted, grainy cream-grey washi paper texture with faint, ghostly silhouettes of distant foliage. Black ink calligraphy runs vertically down the left side, punctuated by two square red artist seals at the bottom-left and one circular seal at the bottom-right. The lighting is soft and flat, emphasizing the crisp black outlines and textured yellow fills.

outputs.title: Autumn Branches and Fruit
outputs.brief: Two distinct ginkgo branches emerge from the right edge, crossing each other slightly to form a layered V-shape. A denser cluster of small, ochre-colored fruits gathers at the top, while the lower branch is weighted by larger, vibrant yellow leaves. The composition is cropped tighter than the reference, filling more of the frame with the electric yellow and deep green foliage. The palette remains strictly within electric yellow, muted sage green, and dark forest green against a beige background. A column of vertical Japanese text is centered on the right margin with a single, large red square seal beneath it.

outputs.title: Ginkgo Leaf Curtain
outputs.brief: A horizontal branch extends across the top third of the frame, from which several thin stems hang vertically like a golden curtain. Large, saturated yellow leaves are spaced evenly, creating a sense of rhythmic balance against a desaturated, textured green-grey background. The bottom half of the poster is primarily negative space, showcasing the grainy washi paper texture. Three small red seals are placed in a triangular formation in the bottom-right corner. All elements are rendered with delicate black outlines and flat color planes typical of Shin-hanga woodblock prints.

outputs.title: Canopy Perspective With Sparrow
outputs.brief: A low-angle view looking upward into the ginkgo canopy, showing a dark brown trunk segment on the left edge. A small, stylized sparrow rendered in muted browns and greys is perched on a branch, surrounded by a halo of electric yellow leaves. The fruits are clustered near the center of the image, appearing as small golden globes against the dark green secondary leaves. The layout uses a circular flow, with branches curving inward from the corners. Vertical black calligraphy is placed in the top-left corner, with a single circular red seal stamped directly under the bird's branch.

outputs.title: Swirling Autumn Wind
outputs.brief: A dynamic composition where a gust of wind carries a swirl of bright yellow ginkgo leaves and fruits in an 'S' curve across the canvas. No branches are visible, creating a minimalist and modern interpretation of the traditional subject. The leaves vary in scale to suggest depth, with some appearing large and blurred in the foreground and others small in the distance. The background is a highly textured, cream-colored washi paper with no other graphic elements. A long, continuous line of vertical calligraphy runs down the far-right edge, accompanied by four different red artist seals of varying sizes scattered near the bottom.
